# Hello!

It's lovely to get to know you all better. 

My name is Kayla, and I'm a nurse from Philly (United States). 

Philly is a city of contradictions, it is known as the **"City of Brotherly Love"** but is also a proud owner of the unofficial city slogan **"No one likes us, we don't care."** 

Most importantly, it is home to the most chaotic sports mascots I've ever seen. 

Of all the cities I've lived in,  it's been my favorite by far.

# Data Science for Health and Social Care

I've been very excited to learn more about data management and manipulation, because good QI is very data dependent! 



# Hobbies
